comment: The class of each tool of fsm that is checked by make rebuild-check (S1); kit finds the tool sources by the layout of the repository and this file classifies them. A tool of an ecosystem that fsm uses as it is is not listed here.

scripts/check-readmes.mts.reason: the check of the required sections and the Korean twin of each README pair of this repository, which no ecosystem tool states
